acceptance_criteria: Table-driven adversarial pairs cover normalization, empty or unknown images, boundary stripping, Unicode, delimiters, and length truncation for every identity component.
Distinct canonical tuples never share equality identity even when they share a display slug or filename segment.
A clear closes only the exact canonical tuple that opened the incident.
A colliding alert remains independently visible and cannot inherit suppression, cooldown, inhibition, renotify, or evidence state.
Dynamic qualified sources have a typed bounded namespace with explicit component boundaries.
Suppression, inhibition, supersession, stale sweep, queued recovery, replay, and known-event lookup verify the full canonical tuple.
An impossible digest collision, key collision, or stored-tuple mismatch fails toward visibility and cannot suppress or clear either condition.
Restart, legacy-state migration, mixed-version operation, rollback, and replay preserve independent incident histories and exact clear ownership.
Helpers no longer reconstruct semantic fields by splitting a lossy persistence key.
Ingress validation is coordinated with source-policy and envelope contracts but collision resistance does not depend on validation alone.
Logs, tests, migrations, and operator receipts expose only bounded enums, counts, and reserved synthetic identifiers.
blast_radius: BOT ERRORS durable incident identity; open and cooldown state; duplicate, inhibition, supersession, flap, stale and recovery logic; queued recovered-before-delivery handling; writefail and replay deduplication; state migration and rollback; producer ingress contracts; and operator evidence derived from incident keys.
evidence_summary: At the pinned revision, incident_key applies a lossy filename sanitizer independently to machine, instance, and qualified source before joining them, while emitters accept unrestricted nonempty identity strings. Durable open, cooldown, suppression, clear, flap, stale, queued-recovery, replay, and known-event operations consume that derived key, and helpers recover source semantics by splitting it. A write-free exact-blob canary reproduced both punctuation-normalization and 80-character truncation collisions: the first synthetic alert opened one incident, a clear for a distinct raw source was actionable, and the clear removed the first source's incident. A scan of 1,106 pinned test files found incident-key coverage in 12 files but no incident-identity collision case; the 38-case dispatcher integration file also lacks one. A final path-level audit found every recorded decisive, test, and affected path disjoint from the exact 6e1672766027c16ecb06f5e122b491c0e5a0a83f to 45f4889ab5f971d920ca6a05bf857d326c42b81d delta; API and SSH main matched the latter revision, so this record is safely repinned. A lead-integrated semantic rereview of merged PR #2595 at exact API and SSH main c37df83897ce9cd02829289f9f05b01347e4b0de inspected every intersecting runtime-manifest, sentinel-pin, and focused-test path. The optional full-manifest digest helper does not alter this issue’s finding, classification, owner boundary, or dependency order; its overlap remains collision-only. A final path-level audit found every recorded decisive, test, and affected path disjoint from the exact c37df83897ce9cd02829289f9f05b01347e4b0de to f0ece2d18883a66f04892a46669b3547e5bdf2b1 delta; API and SSH main matched the latter revision, so this record is safely repinned.
falsifier_or_remaining_gap: A versioned structured identity implementation would falsify the defect only if adversarial pairs for every component retain distinct equality identity and a clear, suppression, replay, migration, or recovery operation cannot act on a mismatched stored tuple. The existing mutation-heavy focused suites were not run because this audit was constrained to creating no temporary artifacts; the exact-blob in-memory lifecycle canary and static all-test scan provide the independent evidence.
impact: Distinct conditions can share suppression, cooldown, inhibition, renotify, severity, and evidence history, or one condition's recovery can retire another condition without recovery proof. Long dynamic qualifiers and ordinary punctuation, Unicode, boundary, empty-image, delimiter, and underscore variants can trigger the defect.
lead_verification_obligations: Re-read the live issue identity, body hash, labels, timestamp, and exact remote main immediately before registry integration or metadata mutation.

Re-enumerate every open pull request file and issue-reference page immediately before assigning an implementation owner, with explicit attention to preservation PR 2495 and documentation collision PR 2084.
Approve the versioned tuple, compact-key verification, legacy dual-read or quarantine, mixed-version, rollback, and exact-clear migration design before implementation.
Coordinate ingress vocabulary with issues 2147 and 2506 without making either issue a prerequisite or combining their unrelated policy work.
Require RED and GREEN matrices across every identity component and every durable lookup, suppression, clear, inhibition, supersession, stale, replay, migration, restart, and recovery consumer.
Verify all emitted, persisted, migration, and test evidence remains bounded and uses reserved synthetic identities only.
Keep live state migration, deployment, restart, queue mutation, service mutation, and message delivery outside the draft implementation pull request.

suggested_remediation: Define incident identity as a versioned bounded tuple with separate display labels. Use unambiguous length-prefixed encoding or a domain-separated digest plus stored-tuple verification for compact keys; validate source and qualifier vocabularies at ingress without making validation the sole collision defense; move every dispatcher consumer away from slug and split semantics; and dual-read or quarantine legacy state without merging histories, manufacturing recovery, resetting cooldowns, or losing exact clear ownership.
